blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A driver faces a 90-day preventive suspension of his license for allegedly blocking a pedestrian lane in Makati City, according to the Land Transportation Office (LTO). In a statement on Friday, the LTO said it issued a show-cause order against the driver and the vehicle’s registered owner. The move of the office follows a video of the incident posted by the Facebook page ‘Silinyador-PH,’ showing that a vehicle stopped directly on a pedestrian lane. This situation forced people to cross elsewhere on the road. “The video also showed other pedestrians being forced to cross at other parts of the road because […]...
